senses.gloss: (b. h.) to be full, v. מָלֵא II.—
units: <cite ref="Tosefta Demai 5:24">Tosef. Dem. V, 24</cite> <he>היאך מְלָאֲךָ ליבך</he> how could thy heart be so full of thyself, i.e. how daredst thou?
<cite ref="Mishnah Eruvin 8:6">Erub. VIII, 6</cite> <he>אין מְמַלְּאִין וכ׳</he> (Y. ed. <he>מְמַלִּין</he>) you must not draw water out of it on the Sabbath.

<cite ref="Bava Batra 162b:5">B. Bath. 162ᵇ</cite> <he>מִילְּאֵהוּ בקרובים</he> if he filled the vacant space on the document with the signatures of relatives; <cite ref="Gittin 87b">Gitt. 87ᵇ</cite>.
<cite ref="Horayot 11b:16">Hor. 11ᵇ</cite> <he>ממלא מקום אבותיו הוה</he> he was filling his ancestors’ place, was a direct successor; a. fr.

<cite ref="Berakhot 3b">Ber. 3ᵇ</cite>; <cite ref="Berakhot 59a:13">59ᵃ</cite> <he>אין הבור מִתְמַלֵּא וכ׳</he>, v. <cite ref="H00347"><he>חוּלְיָא</he> I</cite>. Y. Succ. III, end, 54ᵃ <he>עד שיִתְמַלֵּא זקנו</he> until he has a full beard. Y. Ber. IX, 13ᵈ bot. <he>הִתְמַלְּאִי דינרי זהב</he> be full of gold denars; <he>והיתה מתְמַלְּאָה</he> and it became filled with &c.
<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 33:3">Gen. R. s. 33</cite> <he>הִתְסַלְּאוּ רחמים אלו על אלו</he> be merciful to one another.
<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 33">Ib.</cite> <he>ראיתי … והִתְמַלֵּאתִי עליה רחמים</he> I saw her in distress and was filled with pity for her; a. fr.
